summary: The video highlights the victory of The Dark Lady faction in the Eve of the Rift event, reminding players to claim their web-based lucky draw rewards. Skratch covers a low-effort strategy for the Crisis Rally Battle, recommending buying Skeleton Keys to unlock high-tier chests and settling supplies instead of fighting risky high-difficulty mobs. He also emphasizes prioritizing Soul Fragments and Mythic Equipment Option Chests in the Rally Shop, while briefly showing his Psychicore progress.
tips: Claim extra Eve of the Rift event rewards by clicking the 'Support faction creators' button to access the external web lucky draw pool.
In the Crisis Rally Shop, prioritize buying Legendary Soul Fragments and Mythic+ Equipment Option Chests over Mini Stamina Bread.

Use the Skeleton Key strategy in Crisis Rally: buy keys in the prep shop, sweep the map for epic and legendary chests, refuel when needed, and settle supplies safely without losing inventory in difficult fights.
Obtain Mythic gear chests from Crisis Rally to accumulate gear for ascending stats on your primary and secondary teams.
title: WE DID IT!! Get Your Rewards & Crisis Rally Tips... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
